product: Local Windows snippet library with floating full/Mini interfaces and global hotkey insertion through SendInput. No automatic typed-abbreviation expansion.
architecture: .NET 8 WPF MVVM using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm. App composes interface-backed services and owns modeless Settings/Help and modal editor/PIN/dialog lifecycles. MainViewModel handles debounced search, selection, commands, security state, busy leases, settings and insertion. Shared DesignSystem resources, vector SymbolIcon, palettes and native appearance/placement helpers provide the UI. Encryption, V3 file format, hotkey registration and input-injection algorithms retained.
test_runner: xUnit via Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk / dotnet test (Windows Desktop runtime required)
lint_notes: Use .editorconfig and .gitattributes LF conventions; no standalone C# linter. Do not suppress existing warnings. Windows WPF cannot launch or execute its testhost on Linux. Use a Windows VM or GitHub-hosted windows-latest for authoritative builds/tests.

ci.test: .github/workflows/test.yml: GitHub-hosted windows-latest; restore, Release build, exact no-build TRX gate, deterministic WPF UI review, self-contained win-x64 publish. Upload test-results, ui-review and TypeIt4Me artifacts.
ci.release: .github/workflows/release.yml: v* tags on windows-latest; build/test/publish/GitHub release.
ci.constraints: Do not move public PR code onto fleet/self-hosted runners. Native SendInput smoke requires an interactive desktop and is excluded from hosted CI.

module_map.App.xaml / App.xaml.cs: DesignSystem resource entry, startup composition, PIN validation, dialog ownership, hotkey refresh, activity tracking and orderly shutdown.
module_map.Views/MainWindow: WindowChrome floating library, virtualized rows, empty/search/locked/error/busy states, Mini Mode, keyboard conventions and native tray.
module_map.Views/SnippetEditorWindow: Form, optional category/captured hotkey, multiline content, count/limit, expandable syntax and inline unsaved-change confirmation; Keep editing is the safe default.
module_map.Views/SettingsWindow: Modeless singleton: appearance, window/tray, PIN management, auto-lock validation, import/export.
module_map.Views/PinEntryWindow: Creation/confirmation and async inline retry validation; char buffers cleared. Scrollable content keeps actions reachable on short work areas.
module_map.Views/MessageWindow / InputWindow: Themed confirmations/information and validated auto-lock input.
module_map.Views/HelpWindow: Accurate commands, keyboard access, tray/Mini instructions, privacy limits and version/attribution.
module_map.Views/Resources: DesignSystem.xaml merges LightTheme + Controls; Controls locally merges Tokens/Icons for deferred template lookup. Shared templates use dynamic semantic brushes.
module_map.Views/*Theme.xaml: Light/Dark/HighContrast palettes share brush keys; high contrast uses Windows system colors.
module_map.ViewModels: Toolkit MainViewModel and SnippetEditorViewModel; commands carry locked/modal/busy guards; editor leaves original unchanged on cancel.
module_map.Models: AppSettings (optional full/Mini placement fields); Snippet (Preview/HotkeyLabel are JsonIgnore display properties).
module_map.Services: Existing storage/crypto/hotkey/input/auto-lock services and interfaces; ThemeService, WindowAppearance, WindowPlacement, HotkeyDisplay, PinHashComparison and bulk notifications.
module_map.TypeIt4Me.Tests: xUnit service/model/view-model tests, RedesignedInteractionTests, Fakes. Save failures and security interaction regressions covered.
module_map.TypeIt4Me.Performance: BenchmarkDotNet benchmarks; unchanged by the redesign.
module_map.tools/UiReview: Separate Windows console/WPF review executable referencing the app and existing fakes. Normal mode renders isolated synthetic states; --startup-smoke runs actual services with an internal data-directory override and a second owned input target process.
module_map.docs: UI-DESIGN.md, VALIDATION.md and real WPF screenshot gallery; captures intentionally omit native chrome.
module_map.app.manifest: asInvoker, Windows 10 compatibility, PerMonitorV2 with PerMonitor fallback.

conventions: Nullable enabled; interface-backed services with test doubles. Keep commands and state in view models; reserve code-behind for native lifecycle/focus and dialog wiring.
Shared semantic brushes and vector icons; no new UI runtime framework. Palettes must preserve component resources and update existing/hidden windows.
Light/dark chosen explicitly; system high contrast overrides. No decorative motion. Minimums: full 320x400, Mini 268x200 DIP.
Keep existing encrypted formats readable; no data migration. Never clear the active PIN halfway through an encrypted operation. Copy imported PIN buffers for async lifetime and clear afterward.
Use owned native file dialogs. Destructive deletion defaults to Cancel. Preserve keyboard flow and accessible icon names.
Capture screenshots with synthetic data only. Native smoke uses a fresh isolated folder on an interactive desktop, never personal AppData.
Version remains 1.8.0; redesign PR does not publish a release.
known_limits: Single-display Windows 11 verification; physical mixed-DPI monitors, Narrator, actual OS high-contrast switching and older-Windows fallback need manual checks. Rendered DPI captures do not prove physical monitor transitions.
SettingsManager still logs save errors without propagating them; encrypted file/PIN metadata are not a two-file transaction. Import failure/corruption recovery belongs in a storage-focused follow-up.
Snippet strings remain in process memory while locked; no guarantee that all plaintext is erased from RAM.
readme_excerpt: # TypeIt4Me [![CI](https://github.com/Avicennasis/TypeIt4Me/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Avicennasis/TypeIt4Me/actions/workflows/test.yml) [![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/Avicennasis/TypeIt4Me/badge)](https://scorecard.dev/viewer/?uri=github.com/Avicennasis/TypeIt4Me) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Avicennasis/TypeIt4Me?display_name=tag)](https://github.com/Avicennasis/TypeIt4Me/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE) Instant access to the text you use every day. TypeIt4Me is a lightweight Windows utility with a floating snippet library, global hotkeys, and local storage, built with .NET 8 WPF. Click a snippet to type it into the last application you used, or assign it a global key combination. Text insertion uses Windows `SendInput` without copying snippet content to the clipboard. Typing an abbreviation does **not** automatically expand it. ## A compact home for useful words - Search names, categories, content, and hotkeys. Insert the selected result with Enter. - Keep the floating window above other apps with the pin button. - Switch to Mini Mode for just search and quick insertion; full and Mini Mode sizes are remembered separately. - Edit names, categories, global hotkeys, and multiline content in a dedicated editor with validation and a command reference. - Choose light or dark colors in Settings. Windows high-contrast colors take priority. - Keep running in the system tray, configure auto-lock, and manage PIN protection and backups in Settings. The screenshots show the current source on Windows 11 with synthetic snippets. See the [complete screenshot gallery](docs/screenshots/README.md), [design system](docs/UI-DESIGN.md), and [verification record](docs/VALIDATION.md). Older release downloads may have the previous interface. ## Install and use Download `TypeIt4Me.exe` from [Releases](https://github.com/Avicennasis/TypeIt4Me/releases). The self-contained Windows x64 build can run without installing the .NET SDK. Build from source for the current development version.
